title: Harness partnership expands from API Gateway to AI Gateway
summary: The generally available integration adds AI asset discovery and behavioral protection around Kong-routed LLM, MCP, and agent traffic. It supports ecosystem breadth but does not establish material revenue.
confirmed: Harness and Kong expanded their existing API security integration to Kong AI Gateway.
Harness says AI Discovery and AI Protection are generally available to joint customers.
uncertain: Joint-customer count, attach rate, pricing, bookings, and revenue contribution were not disclosed.
